ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Rubeus Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the hacktool Rubeus via PE information of command line parameters

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\Rubeus\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Rubeus\.exe" OR process_description = "Rubeus" OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*asreproast\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dump\\ \\/service\\:krbtgt\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dump\\ \\/luid\\:0x.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*kerberoast\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*createnetonly\\ \\/program\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ptt\\ \\/ticket\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/impersonateuser\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*renew\\ \\/ticket\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*asktgt\\ \\/user\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*harvest\\ \\/interval\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*s4u\\ \\/user\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*s4u\\ \\/ticket\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hash\\ \\/password\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*golden\\ \\/aes256\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*silver\\ \\/user\\:.*")))
